recipe-tp4-v0.34 (TTFT ≤ 2 s, TPOT ≤ 20 ms): met, but not with 95 % confidence (a p99's upper bound is above the target, or the windows had too few requests to bound it): a longer measurement may confirm a lower rate.

recipe-tp4-v0.34: the capacity was measured with quick settings (120 s confirmation windows, 2 repeats). Longer windows meet more of the rare slow requests, so a full measurement (--window 600 --repeats 5) can confirm a lower rate: plan with headroom.

recipe-tp4-v0.34 (TTFT ≤ 2 s, TPOT ≤ 50 ms): at capacity the TPOT target binds first (p99 43.6 ms, 87 % of its limit; TTFT at 27 %). Decode sets the capacity: more tokens per step (a larger batch, speculative decoding) or faster decode kernels are where to look.

recipe-tp4-v0.34: the power counted is every GPU board (8 GPUs), 2,691 W at capacity against 2,375 W on the serving GPU boards; with no node meter readable here, the node's CPUs, memory, any NvSwitches, fans, disks, NICs and PSU losses are not in it.
recipe-tp4-v0.34: at the most common price ($0.30 / $1.20 per M tokens) it earns $6.29 per GPU-hour at full load; the $5.29 rent is paid from 84 % utilisation.
Accuracy 94.0 % on gsm8k 5-shot, 50 items (95 % interval 83.8 to 97.9 %): a gate against a configuration that breaks the model; scores closer than about 7 points are within its noise.
